meta.note: Starter lists for the Frost and Fire schools. Subtle, hidden-world work, not battlefield spectacle. Female Human/Elf casters only, like all active magic.

rime_latch.name: Rime Latch
rime_latch.description: A thin rime forms on a lock, hinge, puddle or latch, making it stick as if the night itself had frozen it. No blast, no storm — only a seam of ice that could have come from the weather.

still_breath.name: Still Breath
still_breath.description: The air in a room or alcove is cooled just enough that voices fall short and breath hangs as a quiet fog. People feel a draught, not a spell.

numb_limb.name: Numb the Limb
numb_limb.description: One hand or foot goes numb, as after a long walk in snow. It can steady a surgeon or spoil a grip. The skin looks merely cold.

white_trail.name: White Trail
white_trail.description: Footprints and scuffs are filmed with a natural-looking rime, or softened as if a frost had come and gone. The tell fades with the morning.

hoarfrost_veil.name: Hoarfrost Veil
hoarfrost_veil.description: A close personal cold, only a few paces across, that dulls scent and sight as a winter fog would. Not a storm and not a weapon of the field — a hiding-cold that still bites the caster.

wicks_friend.name: Wick's Friend
wicks_friend.description: A candle, pipe, lamp or damp wick takes, or a small brand warms in the hand. There is no tongue of flame leaping from the empty air, only a coal that might have been nursed from a spark.

banked_stone.name: Banked Stone
banked_stone.description: Heat settles into a stone, iron cup or brick and stays there for hours, as a banked hearth would, with no open fire to betray a camp.

fever_touch.name: Fever Touch
fever_touch.description: A body flushes with sudden heat: enough to break a shivering chill, or to leave someone feverish and unfocused. It looks like illness, not a wound.

soot_screen.name: Soot Screen
soot_screen.description: A brief bloom of soot and smoke, as from a badly trimmed lamp or a wet fire, enough to cover a retreat across a room. Not a thrown flame and not a burning wall.

cinder_mark.name: Cinder Mark
cinder_mark.description: A faint heat-brand is left on skin, wood or cloth. It is almost invisible until warmed, when the mark darkens as if a cinder had rested there.
